description: The blade of a fallen king, it allows you to move unseen and strike from the shadows.
trivia: The item's internal name is invis sword (invisibility Sword).

In the original DotA, this item was called Lothar's Edge, a reference to Sir Anduin Lothar from the Warcraft universe. It is still commonly referred to as "Lothar" or "Lothar's" by those who have played the original DotA.
Kunkka's cosmetic item, Kunkka's Shadow Blade, is based on Shadow Blade.

notes: If the invisibility ends without attacking, the bonus damage is lost.
abilities.description:
Makes you invisible for 17 seconds, or until you attack or cast a spell. While Shadow Walk is active, you move 20% faster and can move through units.

If attacking to end the invisibility, you gain 175 bonus physical damage on that attack.

name: Shadow Blade
